senses.gloss: (a transposed denom. of קָטֵיגוֹר) to denounce, bring charges; to incite anger against.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:6:2">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין השטן מְקַטְרֵג וכ׳</he> Satan brings charges against man only in the hour of danger.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:6:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בשלשה … מצוי לקַטְרֵג</he> on three occasions Satan is ready to bring charges; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> (not <he>למקטרוג</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:6:7">Y. Snh. II, 20ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קִיטְרְגוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="J00158"><he>יו״ד</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:3">Cant. R. to V, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>, end <he>עמד הדיין … והמְקַטְרֵג הולך וכ׳</he> when the judge rises, the advocate is silenced, and the accuser goes to carry out his mission (of punishment).
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:12">Esth. R. to III, 8</cite> <he>כל מה שהיה המן מקטרג וכ׳</he> against every charge that Haman preferred against Israel here below, Michael spoke in their defence above.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 74:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIV</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 66:6">Is. LXVI, 6</cite>) <he>ההיכל מקטרג</he> (ed. Bub.) the destroyed Temple is the accuser; <he>ומהו מק׳ וכ׳</he> and what does it say in the way of accusation? Hear the voice of the Lord &c.; Yalk. ib. 809; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be denounced. Esth. R. l. c. אין בניך מִתְקַטְרְגִין וכ׳ thy children are denounced (by Haman) not for worshipping idols, nor for unchastity or bloodshed, but they are denounced only because they observe thy laws.
